verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several built-in AI insight and suggestion features. Data insights automatically uncovers patterns and runs statistical analysis using queries generated from table metadata. Conversational analytics lets users have natural-language conversations with their data through configurable data agents, now including market basket analysis. Gemini in BigQuery also generates and suggests SQL/Python, explains queries, and lets users explore and visualize data in natural language via data canvas. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these Gemini insight features deliver useful results in practice.
